items.title: Pay income tax back-payment (Nachzahlung) for 2025
items.quote: Die Nachzahlung von 1.284,00 € ist bis zum 04.05.2027 fällig.
items.computation: The letter explicitly sets the due date as 04.05.2027. Checking the weekday: 01.01.2027 is a Friday, so 04.05.2027 falls on a Tuesday - not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so no shift under §108 Abs. 3 AO is needed. The stated date stands.

items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
items.computation: Posting date (Aufgabe zur Post) = 25.03.2027 (Thursday). The letter states the simple-letter delivery fiction: bekannt gegeben am vierten Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post (§122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO) = 25.03.2027 + 4 days = 29.03.2027. However, Easter Sunday 2027 falls on 28.03.2027 (computed via the Gaussian Easter algorithm), making 29.03.2027 Ostermontag, a statutory public holiday in every German Land including Bremen. Per the established AO administrative practice (AEAO zu §122), when this fictional delivery day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, delivery is deemed to occur on the next business day: 30.03.2027 (Tuesday). The one-month Einspruchsfrist then runs 'vom Ende des Tages' of that Bekanntgabe day, i.e. the day itself is excluded from the count (§187 Abs. 1 BGB via §108 Abs. 1 AO), and per §188 Abs. 2 BGB a month-long period that begins this way ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number: 30.04.2027. That day is a Friday and not a Bremen public holiday, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The fictional delivery day (29.03.2027, 4th day after posting) falls on Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday; the Einspruch deadline above (30.04.2027) assumes the standard shift of the fiction to the next business day (30.03.2027) — please verify the letter's actual arrival date, since if it genuinely arrived later than this legal fiction, the one-month deadline would shift accordingly (the letter itself notes the fiction does not apply if the Bescheid 'nicht oder zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt zugegangen ist').
